setAnimationComponent-actor.label: Actor
setAnimationComponent-actor.tip: Set the animation component of this actor

setAnimationComponent-motion.label: Motion
setAnimationComponent-motion.tip:
Select a motion of the animation.
The animation ID plus the motion ID form the ID of the animation component.
Therefore, components with the same animation and motion cannot be added repeatedly.

set-angle.name: Set Angle
set-angle.tip: Angle affects the direction of the motion

set-opacity.name: Set Opacity
set-opacity.tip: Opacity affects the visibility of the animation

set-priority.name: Set Priority
set-priority.tip: Sorting priority of the animation component

set-offsetY.name: Set Offset Y
set-offsetY.tip: Vertical offset distance of the animation rendering position

setAnimationComponent-angle.label: Angle
setAnimationComponent-angle.tip: Angle affects the direction of the motion

setAnimationComponent-opacity.label: Opacity
setAnimationComponent-opacity.tip: Opacity affects the visibility of the animation (0 ~ 1)

setAnimationComponent-priority.label: Priority
setAnimationComponent-priority.tip:
Sorting priority of the animation component
 - Less than 0: The animation component is displayed below actor animation
 - Greater than or equal to 0: The animation component is displayed above actor animation

setAnimationComponent-offsetY.label: Offset Y
setAnimationComponent-offsetY.tip: Vertical offset distance of the animation rendering position (unit: pixel)

setAnimationComponent-spriteId.label: Sprite Name
setAnimationComponent-spriteId.tip: Select the sprite you want to change

setAnimationComponent-image.label: Image
setAnimationComponent-image.tip: Select a new image as the sprite image
